data.name: Every Legend
data.detailed_description:
A New Legend Every Time


Every Legend is a text-based AI RPG where the story is generated around your choices. Create a hero, enter your actions in your own words, and watch the adventure unfold through dynamic narration, characters, quests, dialogue, images, speech, and music.

This is a passion project about exploring what role-playing games can become when AI is used as the engine for living stories instead of fixed scripts. The goal is to create adventures that react to you, surprise you, and feel different every time you begin again.

Shape the Story With Your Actions


You are not limited to a small set of dialogue options. Type what your character tries to do, and the game continues the story based on your choices. Sneak past enemies, talk your way out of danger, investigate strange ruins, betray an ally, rescue a stranger, or do something unexpected.

  • Create a custom hero and backstory to start a new fantasy adventure.
  • Type free-form actions instead of choosing from fixed options.
  • Explore generated stories, quests, scenes, and characters.
  • Experience AI-generated narration, dialogue, images, speech, and music.
  • Play a different adventure every time.
  • Use bundled local AI models or configure optional cloud AI providers.

Built Around AI-Generated Role-Playing


Every Legend uses AI to generate the world as you play. The game can create story events, NPCs, locations, combat situations, descriptions, portraits, voices, and atmospheric music based on the current adventure.

The experience is experimental by design. Generated content can be surprising, strange, dramatic, funny, inconsistent, or imperfect. Part of the project is improving that experience over time with player feedback.

Local and Optional Cloud AI


The game includes bundled local AI support for some features, so parts of the experience can run on your own machine. Players can also configure optional third-party AI providers in the settings if they want to use their own API keys.

For the best experience, cloud AI providers are recommended because they can usually provide higher quality, faster, and more consistent generation than local models on many PCs. As one example, Venice AI can provide the required text, image, and speech models through a single provider account. There is no affiliation or sponsorship. AI-generated music is currently handled separately through Suno.

External AI services are optional. The game does not include microtransactions, subscriptions, or in-game purchases for AI usage. If you choose to use external providers, any provider costs are handled directly through your own account with that provider.

Early Access


Every Legend is playable now, but still growing. During Early Access, the focus is on improving generated content quality, usability, story consistency, onboarding, and the systems that make each adventure feel meaningful.

Future ideas being explored include story sharing, online story setup lists with ratings and descriptions, multiplayer adventures, and a mode where one player can act as a DM to guide or review AI outcomes before they happen.

Player feedback will strongly influence which systems are improved or added next.

A Personal Note


AI as a creative tool, and the future it can open for games, is a personal passion of mine. I love exploring what is possible with it, and I plan to keep following new developments in the AI world and experiment with ways to bring the best ideas into Every Legend.

But the main goal is simple: the player should have a fun experience that they shape and own. AI is the tool, not the point. Your choices, your hero, your story, and the legend you create are what the game is built around.

data.short_description: Every Legend is a text-based AI RPG where each adventure is generated around your choices. Create your hero, type your actions, explore branching stories, meet unique characters, and shape a new legend every playthrough.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 6 GB / AMD Radeon RX 580 8 GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 12 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Local AI generation requires a DirectX 12 compatible GPU. Cloud AI providers may reduce local hardware requirements.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
